{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄逢冲破，吉處藏㐫；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936449070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命宫逢禄存，或三合有禄，却被忌來冲防，反為㐫兆。如限步到於禄位，㐫星同聚，亦以為㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬遇空亡，終身奔走，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936465454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲生人，正截路空亡在申，傍空在酉，若安命在申，主人終身奔走，冝僧道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢敗地，發也虚花。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936481838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如土水人安命在已為絶地，刼得金生在已，生水不絶，為母来救子之理。凢寅申巳亥為四绝，又為四生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星臨庙旺，再觀生尅之機；命坐強宫，細察制化之理。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936498222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如水土生人，墓庫在辰，若與財帛同度，為財庫；與官禄同為官庫，與禄存同為天庫，耗殺同為空庫，迁移同為破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175730388729868"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庫。凢辰、戍丑未為四墓庫，此亦属纳音而論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月最嫌反背，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936514606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如日在酉戍亥子丑，月在卯辰巳午未，皆為反背，仍肴上弦、下弦。月在上弦皇日吉，下弦晦日凶。若日月同垣，便看人生時日喜、太陽月喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂方可論禍福；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936514606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬最喜交馳，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936530990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲禄在寅，而申子辰馬亦在寅，遇此得地，謂之禄馬交馳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡定要得用，天空最為𦂳要。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936547374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命宫惟金空則鳴，火空則發，二限逢之，反為福論。若水空則泛，木空則折，土空則䧟，為禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢敗地，専看扶持之曜，大有竒功。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936563758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命在敗绝地，又禄存化禄扶持反羙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175678975098895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫㣲天府，全依輔弼之功；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936580142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命遇紫府，又得輔弼守照，終身冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺破軍，專依羊鈴之虐。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936596526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身、命遇七殺、破軍，又㑹羊、鈴守照，有制，反可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星吉，逢㐫也吉，諸星凶，逢吉也㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936612910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如三方身命，但吉多凶少，則㐫多吉少則㐫。仍㸔吉㐫星得垣失陷，與夫生尅制化，以定禍福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼夾帝為上品，桃花犯主為至滛。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936629294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命紫微，與貪狼同垣，男女邪滛奸詐，巧計施机，若得輔弼夾帝，貪狼受制，則不拘此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君臣慶㑹，才善經邦。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936645678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如紫㣲守命，得天相、昌曲；天府得天同、天梁相助；紫微得夾，為君臣慶會，逢之，無不冨貴。但有金星與刑、忌、四耗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175730388779020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"同度，謂之奴欺主、臣蔽君，反為禍乱命是也。湏要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推詳如安禄山","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936662062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁鉞同行，位居台輔，禄文拱命，貴而且賢，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936678446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如魁鉞守身命，兼得权禄昌曲吉曜來拱，無不冨貴。但有刑忌相冲，則平常。只冝僧道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬頭𢃄箭，鎮禦邉疆。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936694830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如午宫安命，遇有天同、貪狼、擎羊，丙、戊人逢之化吉，雖以羊刃在命以為羙論，冨貴皆可許也，只不耐乆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚夾印，刑杖惟司，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936711214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命有天相，却被羊貞夾之，主人招官，非受刑杖，終身，不能發逹只冝僧。道可免禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善䕃朝綱，仁慈之長。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936727598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如机、梁二星守身命，在辰戍宫，兼化吉相助，以為冨貴，加刑忌耗殺，僧道冝之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人貴郷，逢者獲禄；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936743982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175783203373071"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命遇有貴人，又兼吉曜權禄来助，逢之無不冨貴。限遇之，亦主發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財居財位，遇者冨奢。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936760366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如紫微天府，武曲居於財帛之宫，又兼化權，禄及禄存，必主冨奢。二限若逢，大主發積。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽居午，謂之日麗中天，有專權之貴，敵國之冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936776750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命坐於午宫，遇有太陽庚辛生人日生時者，冨貴全羙。女人逢之，在夫益子，封贈夫人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂居子，號曰水登桂蕚，得清要之職，忠諫之材。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936793134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假加身命坐於子官，遇有大隂，丙丁生人，夜生時者，冨貴全羙，心無私曲，有忠諫之材。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微輔弼同宫，一呼百諾。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936809518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如紫微守於身命，有左右同宫來扶持，冨貴終身，以為全美之論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文耗居寅卯，衆水朝東，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936825902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175730388844556"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命居寅卯，遇昌曲破軍，却有刑殺冲破，一生驚險，限歩到此，湏逢吉則平，遇㐫更不吉，終身辛苦，费心劳力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月守不如照，合䕃福聚，不怕㐫危。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936842286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如日月守身命，雖會吉曜，不為全羙；如逢㐫星，定有㐫灾。如是三合於命，兼化吉以為羙。◯蔭、福即天梁、天同。如在身命逢吉，不怕㐫灾，便有刑忌不論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪居亥子，名為泛水桃花；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936858670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命坐於亥子，遇貪狼，逢吉曜，以吉論。如遇刑忌，男浪蕩，女滛娼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑遇貪狼，號曰風流綵杖。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936875054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如貪狼羊刃同垣，身命於寅宫，為人聦明，更主風流，若遇閑宫，則平矣。余詳之，非也。寅宫無擎羊到位，只有陀羅所值，後學要明此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺𤎉貞同位，路上埋屍；破軍暗曜同郷，水中作塚。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936891438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175783203536911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命值此二星守之，加化忌耗殺，方可依此断。或在迁移宫亦然。暗曜指巨門，亦同上断。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄居奴僕，縱有官也奔馳；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936907822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命宮星平，奴僕官，又得禄存，及化權禄吉曜，以為美論，只為人多劳碌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝遇㐫徒，雖獲吉而無道。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936924206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如紫㣲守於身命，遇有權禄，刑忌同位，雖吉無凶，只為人心術不正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝坐命庫，則曰金轝扶御輦；臨官同文曜，號為衣錦惹天香。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936940590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如紫微守命宫，命前有吉曜者來呼號是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0170/1/ref/1jw0gc0ofdyqu/1-1712049828085.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=7azoHjFmIqYAa4NFEZq7F0mDHG8%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0170/1/ref/1jw0gc0ofdyqu/1-1712049828085.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"作大權之聀，臨官同文昌曲于福德宫亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽會文昌於官禄，皇殿首班之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936956974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如太陽會文昌於官祿，官逢吉瞳，冨貴全美，必作宰相之聀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂同文曲於妻宫，蟾宫折桂，文章令盛。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936973358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175806401937427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂文曲同於妻官，又兼吉曜來扶限歩，又逢至此。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936989742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子蟾宫折桂，女子招貴封贈。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937006126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿存守於田財，則堆金積玉；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937022510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如禄、存星守于田、財二宫，主大冨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財䕃坐於遷移，必巨啇高賈。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937038894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財即武曲，䕃即天梁，此二星或一化權，禄與吉星坐宫迁，必作巨移啇高賈，若加刑，忌殺凑平常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺居絶地，天年，夭似顔囘；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937055278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命坐寅申巳亥，逢七殺加刑忌，又值某星所絶，縦有吉曜合照，限臨則㐫矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗居禄位，沿途乞食。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937071662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如耗星守官禄宫，文逢刑忌及家午戊生人，命坐午宫、","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937088046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳酉丑生人，命坐酉宫，亥卯未生人，命坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯宫，申子辰生","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937088046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人命坐子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937088046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175867752169524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪㑹旺宫，終身𣆨𥩈，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937104430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如耗星會貪狼，守身命官禄之位，主為人貧窮，終身為𥩈盗之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌暗同居命宫，疾厄困弱尫嬴，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937120814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命宫疾厄，官逢巨門，擎羊陀羅，為人貧困軟弱，終身不旺，不能發逹。忌乃陀羅，暗乃臣門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫星㑹於遷移，父母刑傷産室。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937137198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如刑忌火鈴，守於迁移父毋官，必主身体軟弱殘疾，祖業破蕩，奔波劳碌之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑殺會𤎉貞於官禄，枷杻同流","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937153582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如刑殺㢘貞，守官祿之官，流年二限到此，不為禍患，定遭刑法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官府夾刑殺於迁移，離郷遭配，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937169966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如𣴑年官府與當生官府夾刑殺於迁移之宮，太嵗小限行到此，必遭刑貶配離祖之論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175806402002963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善福守於空位，天竺生涯。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937186350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假加身命坐於空位，乃本宫無星辰也。天机天同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合照","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937202734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必主僧道，逢吉福厚，遇㐫奔波。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼單坐命宫，離宗庶出","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937219118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命無正曜，更有左右守昭，必難為父毋自小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離宗；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937219118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"偏房庶出之羙為是，如左右单守，在命宫亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺臨於身命，逢流殺，必定死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937235502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命坐七殺，流年太嵗、刑、忌併臨，必主災病、官非、破財、人口死亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊鈴合於命宫，遇白虎湏當刑戮。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937251886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如羊鈴刑殺，坐守於命官流年，白虎又臨，必主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官非破","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937268270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財生災，定遭刑戮，又或小口死亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官府𤼵於吉曜，流殺怕逢破軍，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937284654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑忌羊火守於身命，運限逢吉曜發財，流年太嵗逢悪曜為㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175867752267828"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊鈴慿太嵗以引行，病符官府皆作禍。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937301038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命逢羊鈴，坐守流年太嵗巡逢到此，必作禍興灾。如命宫有犯病符官府，更兼太嵗亦到，必主官非口舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏書慱士與流禄，盡長吉祥；力士将軍同青龍，主題權勢。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937317422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命坐宫，原有吉曜，流年又遇奏書事士，流禄将軍青龍，必主當年發福之荣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"童子限如水上浮泡，老人限似燃燭。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937333806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命坐宫，原有悪曜，流年囚火，太嵗等殺又到此，皆主作禍生災。小児老人若見之，不冝也。中年人尚平和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵入命俱從寅上起，正月順数至本生月止。","logicSentenceId":"7580337533881974818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又自人生月上起子時，逆至本生時安命，順至本生時安身。","logicSentenceId":"7580337533881991202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如正月生子時，就在寅宫安命身。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084845108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑時逆轉丑安命，順去卯安身；寅時逆轉，子安命，順至辰安身。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084861492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘宫倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084877876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又若閠正月生者，要在二月内起安身命，凢有閠月，俱要依此為例。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084894260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音甲子歌，務要熟讀。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084910644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就如甲生人安命在寅，却起甲巳之年丙寅首是丙寅丁卯炉中火，就去火局尋某日生期起紫微帝主。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084927028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是正月初一日生者，是火局酉宫，有初一日，就","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084943412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330176278257205285"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從酉宫起紫㣲，庶無差悞。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084943412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若錯了，則差之毫厘，失之千里矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084959796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順至生時便歸藏。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084976180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子乙丑海中金，丙寅丁卯炉中火，戊辰己巳大林木，","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085025332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330176346343079971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午辛未路傍土，壬申癸酉劔鋒金。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085025332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌乙亥山頭火，丙子丁丑澗下水，戊寅已卯城頭土，庚辰辛巳白臘金，壬午癸未楊柳木。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085041716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申乙酉泉中水，丙戍丁亥屋上王，戊子已丑霹靂火，庚寅辛卯松栢木，壬辰癸巳長流水。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085058100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午乙未沙中金，丙申丁酉山下火，戊戌巳亥平地木，庚子辛丑壁上土，壬寅癸卯金泊金。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085074484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰乙巳覆灯火，丙午丁未天河水，戊申巳酉大驛土，庚戍辛亥釵釧金。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085090868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子癸丑桑柘木，甲寅乙卯大溪水。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085107252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰丁巳沙中土，戊午巳未天上火，庚申辛酉石橊木，壬戍癸亥大海水。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085123636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子時戍上起文昌，逆到生時是貴郷。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085172788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文曲数從辰上起，文昌星從戌上起子時，如人生子時，就在戍宫安；若丑時逆至酉宫安之。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085189172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文曲星從辰上起子時，若人生子時，就在辰宫安，若丑時順去巳宫安之，餘宫星此。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085205556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化忌星水為多管之神，守身命，一生不順，招是非。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534216756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小限逢之，一年不足；大限相遇，十年悔吝。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534233140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限并太𡻕交臨，断然蹭蹬。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534249524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文人不耐乆，武人縱有官災，口舌不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534265908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖啇賈藝人，在𠙚不冝，難立脚。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534282292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如㑹紫府、昌曲左右科。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534298676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權禄與忌同宫，又𠔥羊火鈴空，作事進退，横發横破，始終不得乆遠，即係發不住財是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534315060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生奔波劳碌，或𢃄疾貧夭，僧道逢亦流移還俗。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534331444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然天同在戌，化忌丁人遇吉；巨門在辰，化忌，辛人返","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534347828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330177966598717475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佳。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534347828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及太陽在寅卯辰巳午化忌，太隂在酉戌亥子化忌，反為福論。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534364212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日月𨺻地化忌，主大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580338561069613071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":n {"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先㸔身命祿馬，不落空亡，天空、截空最緊，旬空次之。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680864831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一看命主吉㐫庙旺，化吉化忌生尅；次看身主吉㐫生尅，三看遷移、財帛、官祿三方星辰刑冲尅破；四看福徳宫權禄刼空庙陷，以福徳對財帛宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680881215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命遷移、財官、福徳六宫，名曰八座，俱在庙旺，聚吉化吉，富貴高壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680897599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六宫俱陥，聚㐫化忌，夭壽貧孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680913983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卯酉時生人者尤緊。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680930367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有田宅疾厄，已録于后。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680946751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看父母妻子三宫俱有刼空殺忌，則僧之命，否則孤獨貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680963135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命宫無正曜者，財官二宫有吉星拱照，富貴","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680979519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178972552036386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全羙；或偏房庶母所生，三方有𢙣星冲照，或二姓可延生離祖，可保成家。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680979519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命官有正曜吉星，庙旺化吉，三方又有吉宿㑹合，上上之命；如無正曜吉星，三方有吉，上次之命。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680995903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命宮星辰無吉無凶，或吉凶相半者，如三方亦有中等星辰，為中格。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681012287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及命宫星辰入庙旺，三方有悪星守照破格，及命星陥背，加羊火化忌，却得十干禄元來相守化吉，亦為中等之命。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681028671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命無吉星，返有凶殺化忌，無禄落陷，為下格之命。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681045055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三方有吉星，亦可為中等，先小後大，不能乆逺，終為成敗夭折論。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681061439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若安命星緾陥地，又加㐫殺化忌，三方又㑹羊陀火鈴空刼，為下格，貧賤二姓延生，奴僕之命，否則夭","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681077823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178794898358326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拆六畜之命","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681077823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論人命入格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命入格，庙旺聚吉，科權禄守上上之。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681094207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命不入庙，加吉化吉科權禄上次之。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681110591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命不入庙，不加吉，平常命入庙不加吉，中等若居陷地，又加殺化忌，為下格之命，不以入格而論也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681126975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又入格不化吉而化㐫，只以本命吉㐫多寡而断之。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681143359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論格星数髙下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫府與数相合何如？","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681159743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微南北斗中天帝王，天府乃南斗主，又有隂陽相半者。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681176127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若隂陽不相半，又数不相生，為下格，隂陽純一為中格，又三方四正皆吉星為上格；吉㐫相半守","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681192511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178972552151074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"照為中格，純是𢙣殺，為下格，㐫徒論。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681192511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡星得上格而数得上格為第一，人臣星得上格而数得中格，為第二，位至三公；星得上格而数得下格，爲第三，位至六卿，皆為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681208895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上夀之人，星得中格而数得上格為第四，位至監司，星中数中為第五，位至縣令，星中数下為第六。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681225279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異路前程、貴題，皆為中等享福之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681241663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又星得下格而数得上格為第七，衣禄豐足，富比陶朱，子孫蕃盛，壽享遐齡，以星雖㐫，而又入格合局故也耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681258047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否虚名虚利，星下数中為第八，衣食無𧇊，星下数下為第九。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681274431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛苦奔波，貧窮夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681290815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上中下三等，依理而断也，則上可以知祖宗之源流，下可以知子孫之昌盛。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681307199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178992400318518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論人性格何如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如身命一星緊一星。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681323583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"緩則禀性不常，喜怒不一，善悪隨風，逐波若善星，守命則賦。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681339967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性仁慈公直，㐫殺守命，禀性悪虐狂妄。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681356351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看金木水火土生尅制化推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681372735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論男女命同異","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女命不同，星辰各别。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681389119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男命先看身命，次看財帛、官禄、遷移，","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681405503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俱要庙旺為吉，敗陷聚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫為㐫，三看福徳、權禄、刼空庙陷、","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681405503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言忌外看田宅妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妾疾厄宫，吉㐫已録。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681405503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干後，又看父母妻","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681421887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子三宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱有刼空殺忌，則僧道之命，否則貧窮孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681421887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏要仔細𠫵詳，方可断人禍福荣枯。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681438271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178972552265762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"女命先爲身命吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如貪狼七殺擎羊則不羙。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681454655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次看福徳，","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681471039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宫吉㐫若七殺单。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居福徳，必為娼婢，三㸔夫君，四看子媳。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681471039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財帛、田宅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若桃花刑殺，要敗絕空亡為吉，若諸吉廟旺，不","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681487423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"佳雖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是艱辛貧困，亦不為下賤夭拆。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681487423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論女因夫貴女命貴格，","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681503807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"反無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用以子媳夫君福徳為正強，田宅財帛為次強，以官禄遷移七宫為𨺻。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681503807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"小児愽士、力士上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短下長，靑龍將軍，腮小頭圓，大耗鼻仰唇縮，死符病符，声髙性雄；官府奏書逢𢙣曜，落地無聲；白虎大嵗遇七殺，防弱遭傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681520191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏分生尅制化之垣，更㸔帝禄盛","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681536575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178992400760886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰之地，復觀関殺，方知壽天窮通。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681536575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢小児初生，命中星辰庙旺，大小二限未行，断其灾少，易養，父母無尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681552959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命坐𢙣殺，又緾陥地，大小二限未行，断其灾多，難養，刑尅父母。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681569343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定小児生時訣：","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681585727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉单頂門，或偏左邉二三分。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681602111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申巳亥亦单頂，偏居右去始為真。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681618495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戍丑未是雙頂，胞胎受定正時辰。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681634879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又子午卯酉面向天，寅申己亥側身眠，辰戌丑未臉伏地，臨盆當試用心堅。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681651263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢男女生在寅午戍、申子辰六陽時，安命在此六宫者吉；生在已酉丑、亥卯未六隂時，安命在此六隂宫者吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681667647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反此則少逐。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681684031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人生子亥二時，最難定凖，要仔細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681700415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子時有十刻，上五刻属昨夜亥時，下五刻属今日子時。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681716799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如天氣隂雨之際，必湏羅經以定真確時候，若差訛，則命不凖矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681733183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論小児尅親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰戌丑未生人，見辰戌丑未時最毒。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681749567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178992400842806"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681765951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子寅卯巳生人，見午、申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥時，主先尅父，出十六歲不論。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681765951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰、已丑末生人，見子午卯、巳亥申酉生時者，主先尅母。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681782335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論命先貧後富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人生於冨貴之家，一生快樂享福，財官題逹，妻荣子貴，奴僕成行，聲名昭著。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681798719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其間有半途遭傷，人離財散，官非火盗。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681815103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身喪家亡，此等之命，非命也，却是限歩逢㐫，大小二限及太嵗相冲照，又加㐫殺守臨，故此破敗不貧，即損壽也，所謂先成後敗，先大後小也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681831487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有人命出身微賤，营活生理，百工巧藝，九流醫術，又為","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681847871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"農圃等軰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初歷艱辛度日，却乃中末平地，升騰發財，驚駭","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681847871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179103183798307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"郷邦，因生在中庸之局，後因限歩相扶，星辰逢吉曜庙旺，以此突然發達進禄，所謂先貧後冨，先小後大是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681847871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論大限十年祸福何如？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫分星緾全吉，庙旺得地，無擎羊陀羅、火鈴空刼者，主十年安静，人財全羙。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681864255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若限内有擎羊、陀羅、火鈴、空刼忌星為伴，成敗不一。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681880639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如宫分星緾䧟，地值擎陀、火鈴、空刼忌，又加流年𢙣殺凑合，及小限巡逢㐫殺，則官災，死亡立見。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681897023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大限将出，有吉星，衆者無災悔，少者災多，損人，破財不利。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681913407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行至寅申巳亥子午宫，遇紫微、天府、天同、太陽、大隂、昌曲、禄存、禄主吉星，主吉星，主人財興旺，添丁進口之慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681929791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行至辰戍","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681946175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179141985140775"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未卯酉，遇𢙣殺、𤎉貞、天使、羊陀、火鈴、空刼忌星，主人酒色荒迷，貧乏死生。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681946175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇左右昌曲，仕宦遷官加職，士民生子發財，婦人喜事，僧道亦利，商賈得益。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681962559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大小二限及大嵗怕行天傷、天使夾地，怕行天空、地刼之地，怕行擎羊、陀羅之地，及羊陀冲照，怕脫㐫限，怕逢㐫限，又怕傷使、刼空、羊陀，併夾歲限。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681978943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如天傷在子，天使在寅，嵗限在丑宫，乃併夾也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681995327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊陀命尚且無用，况夾限乎？","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106721334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逃得過，湏看夀星、紫微、天同、天梁、貪狼坐命可觧。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106737718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更湏看月值𢙣殺，日值惡殺，加凑大小嵗月日時五者叅詳吉㐫推断，","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106754102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗行至奏書将。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106770486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軍直符、天使、天傷、羊陀、火鈴、空刼忌星逢一二位，主人離","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106786870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179200889946127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財散，疾病、哭泣之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106786870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若嵗限犯重月日一二位，又逢忌星合者，官吏遭謫，常人招橫事，婦人損胎，病者死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106803254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若𢙣殺在不得地，如風雨暴過。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106819638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若歲限臨無吉星，命中無故，其年難過，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106836022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論二限太嵗吉㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏詳大限獨守，吉㐫何如，小限獨守，吉㐫何如？","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106852406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗獨守，吉㐫何如？","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106868790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲限俱㐫則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106885174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看大限與小限相逢，吉㐫何如。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106901558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太限逢太嵗，吉㐫何如？","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106917942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小限逢太嵗，吉㐫何如，禍福尢𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106934326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看太歲冲大限、小限，太嵗冲羊陀七殺，然後可断夀夭荣枯。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106950710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179141985239079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論行限分南北斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽男隂女，南斗為福；隂男陽女，北斗為福。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106967094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北斗諸星吉㐫，大限断上五年應，小限断上半年應。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106983478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南斗諸星吉㐫，大限断下五年應，小限斷下半年應。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106999862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論流年太嵗逢吉㐫星殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"几太嵗看三方對照星辰，吉㐫何如，以定禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107016246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗在命宫行，看禍福尤𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107032630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命在子宫，太嵗到子，又癸生人，逢吉則吉，遇㐫則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107049014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論隂隲延夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂隲延夀生百福，雖然倒限不遭傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107065398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如有人大小二限及","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107081782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179200890109967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗到㐫陥地，有延過壽去不死者，還是其人曾行隂隲。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107081782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平曰利物濟人，反身修徳，以作善降祥，雖㐫不害。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107098166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如宋郊編荻橋渡蟻是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107114550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如諸葛亮火燒藤甲軍，傷人太毒，减夀一紀，當以此𠫵詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107130934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論羊陀迭併","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚生人，命在卯宫，遷移在酉宫，如遇羊陀流年，亦庚禄居申，流羊在酉，流陀在未，是命在卯宮，原有酉宫擎羊冲合流年，又遇流羊流陀，謂之羊陀迭併","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107147318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論七殺重逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命中三合原有七殺守照，而流年又遇流羊、流陀冲照，謂","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107163702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179141985320999"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之七殺重逢，二者為禍最毒，入庙災晦减輕。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107163702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如𨺻地逢忌，及卯酉遇擎羊，為閑宫，午生人不利也。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107180086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然七殺逢吉曜，衆亦轉㐫化吉，不可一槩論㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107196470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擎羊、陀羅、七殺，逢紫微天相、禄存三合拱照，可觧","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107212854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：羊陀迭併命難逃，七殺重逢禍必遭。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107229238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：太嵗二限臨此地，十生九死不堅牢。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107245622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論大小二限星辰過十二宫遇十二夫人所忌訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇此主災悔，官非孝服，火盗破財，刑傷，死亡立見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生子命忌寅申，假如子年生人，切忌寅申嵗限，災悔至重。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107262006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及忌子午嵗限","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107278390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179292686499855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相冲。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107278390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑午生人丑午嗔。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107294774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如丑生人忌午丑嵗限，午生人亦忌丑午歲限，及忌七殺星，災悔極重。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107311158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯之人防已亥，假如寅卯人忌己亥嵗限，及忌卯酉寅申相冲。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107327542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇龍切忌本身臨。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107343926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如巳生人忌逢已年，及忌行到巳限；辰生人忌行辰年，及忌行到辰限為天羅文忌到戍爲地綱限，遇此主灾殃水厄之險，官非破財，憂制連連。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107360310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179141985402919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申人鈴火災殃重。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107376694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如申生人，忌逢火鈴二星，必主災悔至重。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107393078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及忌寅年冲。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107409462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未遇猪鷄墓患殷。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107425846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如未生忌逢酉亥歲限，又忌見擎羊在四墓宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107442230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍亥羊陀湏避忌。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107458614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如戍亥生人，忌遇羊陀，災重。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107474998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍生人又忌行到戌宫嵗限為地網，又忌行到辰宫嵗限為天羅，為之辰戌相冲，","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107491382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不羙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉人陀刃亦非親。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107507766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如酉生人亦忌羊陀星歲限，及忌行卯宫限，及卯年歲君相冲","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107524150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179292686614543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌：猪犬生人莫遇陀，辰戍切忌到綱羅。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107540534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：預先整頓衣冠木，未免生人唱挽歌。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107556918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論立命行限宫歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌：","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107573302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金人遇坎命湏傷，木命逢離有禍殃。水遇良宫應蹇滯，火來兑上禍難藏。土到東南逢震巽，曰湏防膿血及驚慌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"命宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三夾命㐫，六夾吉。三夾是刼空、火鈴、羊陀是也。六夾是紫府左右昌、曲、魁、鉞、科、權、禄、日月命是㐫多吉少，雖吉也在也㐫，吉多㐫少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖㐫也吉，身命三方，仍看庙旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319365695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命無正曜，二姓延生。","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319382079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或過房出維，隨母継拜入贅，或又是庶毋所生者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330180076795052066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限逢㐫曜，柳縁桃紅而易謝。","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319414847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命逢㐫限，庙旺猶發逹，限㐫星陥，必㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音墓庫，看何宫，","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319529535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如水生人庫辰，遇財官或禄存尤妙。遇遷移耗殺同不美，生逢敗地，發也虚花。如年納音水土長生居申，申乃金星，為本宫之主，若安命在耗殺酉敗地，又羊同不美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得禄存吉","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319529535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"絶處逢生，花而不敗。如水土絶在巳，安命在巳為絶地，却得金星在得已生水，佳禄，不主禄絶方，餘倣此。吉同吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"財帛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日月夾財，加吉曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不權則富","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319545919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如財帛宫在未，天府星守，日在午，月在申，夾財是也。左右財宫兼夾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱衣禄，豊隆","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319545919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如左右同財帛宫，又或財宫在丑，日在子，月在寅，是夾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"財宅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存子午位遷移，身命逢之利禄冝。","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319693375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺羊刄二官符，離鄉遭配；","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319742527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當生及流年官符是也。又行嵗限，在遷移宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四殺遷移父母宫，身危祖蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319742527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330180187092467727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昌曲貪狼于巳亥，遭官刑囚；𤎉貞羊殺於官禄，枷杻難逃；","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319775295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"妾妾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微守命，坐寅方，天府同宫最妙。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700044976147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右昌曲合，加㑹两相幇，七殺朝拱，掌握威揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700044992531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌合，星斗明朗。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045008915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再詳命主某星循良，夀元乘旺，富夀無疆，台輔暗拱，景星鳯凰。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045025299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天門月照，声價琳瑯。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045041683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光射斗牛，普照四方。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045058067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身星坐某，福履康荘，五行無尅，藍玉生光。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045074451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注人現瑋，邦家柱梁。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045090835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佳人破軍，重卜坤裳。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045107219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四宫坐貴，三杰傳芳。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045123603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茲行某限，吉星之郷，名登仕籍，日出扶桑，峥嵘頭角，烏帽錦裳，双南溢笥，九粟盈倉。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045139987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"維皇眷徳，福壽陵崗。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045156371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蟾從觸後，愈暢輝光。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045172755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耒春某月，左輔文昌，化科","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045189139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330181976298848308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得令，政績著揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045189139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某年某星，夜雨消湘，財丁損抑，骨肉参啇，愬匕終吉，視履考祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045205523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喬遷某限，彩鳯翶翔，出司郡佐，報績聖皇，希踪卓魯，接武龔黄。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045221907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"部院綵徼，交馳旌揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045238291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名崇五岳，利湧三湘。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045254675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肖嗣脫頴，蘭吐天香。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045271059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某限逢陀，尤見剥床。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045287443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某星救護，意兹蕭墻。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045303827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秗風乍起，蓴鱸味香，逢冠高掛，荣旋錦堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045320211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十年某限，福夀寧康，重裀列𪔂，冠盖鏘匕。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045336595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天夀星輔，愈熾愈昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045352979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"垂封之祝，嘖匕道傍。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045369363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟到某星，雲掩無光，梁木其壊，哲人云亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045385747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045402131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命坐午垣，巨門石中，隠玉明彰，逢生無尅，理𠫭詳三方四正，","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045418515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330181603253223465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，福夀等陵崗。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045418515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右弼歸垣互守，化權，掌楃鏗鏘。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045434899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身宫魁鉞拱，貴格豈尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045451283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注人丰神卓偉，表匕景星鳯凰，胸懷今右冨琳瑯。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045467667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功名應有待，何必恁惶。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045484051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"匕。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045500435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次究星命：某星逢得地，高強，竒哉。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045516819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水會蛇卿，文昌文曲畫光芒。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045533203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加㑹得照合，定擬發科。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045549587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官福二宫星美，生平作事端荘，身居奴僕静中。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045565971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忙妻宫逢七殺，正副免刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045582355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"児宫擎羊作踐，先虚後實飛黃。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045598739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"現今限步正輝光。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045615123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早奪焚舟計，雷劍吐光芒。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045631507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小限恩光台輔，文宗取試名揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045647891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀塲補廪喜洋匕流昌曲星集，誰識一穿揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045664275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某限行耒題逹，中年貪武為良，門庭生色喜非常。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045680659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財源春水漲，志氣吐眉揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045697043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某年忌某星，冝慎内外憂傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045713427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045729811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330181976298913844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冝懲忿恣，親善逺奸狂。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045729811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某限交来匕殺紫微制伏禎祥，巍然超拔声名香。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045746195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拜官居百里，徳政嫓襲黄。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045762579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某年有所畏忌，湏知到此驚慌。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045778963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尚喜某星為福，依然福履無疆。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045795347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行交某限，十年康。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045811731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"部院馳綵撽，黔庻植甘棠。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045828115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某限桑榆暮景，東籬陶菊金黃，篿鱸羙味逕三荒。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045844499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二䟽從斛組，看子紹書香。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045860883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某年某星為忤，某星相黨相戕，俄然一夣熟黄梁。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045877267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哲人其蒌矣，空為裂肝腸。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045893651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
